sources.label: Chrome or Edge (lab speed, rendered pages)
Common Crawl web graph (free backlinks and authority)
Google Search Console API (real queries, clicks, positions)
Bing Webmaster Tools API (free key; keyword volumes)
sources.unblock: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools, create an API key (Settings > API access), set BING_WEBMASTER_KEY (in the environment or in the .env file given with --env-file).

sources.label: Chrome UX Report API (free; real-visitor speed)
sources.unblock: Google Cloud console: enable 'Chrome UX Report API', create a free API key, set CRUX_API_KEY. Low-traffic sites may have no field data (a result, not a failure).

sources.label: PageSpeed Insights API (free key; Google's own phone speed test, the trusted number when this machine is busy)
sources.unblock: Google Cloud console: enable 'PageSpeed Insights API', create a free API key, set PSI_API_KEY (in the environment or in the .env file given with --env-file).

sources.label: Gemini API free tier with Google Search grounding (AI citations)
sources.unblock: aistudio.google.com: create a free API key, set GEMINI_API_KEY.

sources.label: Google Ads Keyword Planner export (free account; volume ranges)
sources.unblock: In Google Ads > Keyword Planner, export the keyword ideas as CSV and give the file path to the research stage.

sources.label: Business Profile data (owner's free API export or a dated manual capture)
sources.unblock: The owner exports the Business Profile (categories, services, reviews) or the main session saves a dated capture of the public listing; give the file to local-profile.mjs.

sources.label: Google map-pack captures per city and device (owner-supervised)
sources.unblock: The main session captures the map pack for each service-area city at human pace and saves them; local-pack.mjs imports them.

sources.label: Gemini terms acknowledged for storing derived citation data
sources.unblock: The owner confirms we may keep derived fields (cited domains, whether we are cited) from grounded Gemini answers; then set PEWP_GEMINI_TERMS_ACK=1 (or ai.geminiTermsAcknowledged in the measure config).

sources.label: Local grid captures (owner-supervised map-pack captures at grid points around each service-area city, mobile)
sources.detail: captures/local/grid/*.json read by scripts/local-grid.mjs import; plan with scripts/local-grid.mjs plan
sources.unblock: Add the city centres (lat, lng, source, date) to captures/local/grid/cities.json, run local-grid.mjs plan, then capture requests.json at human pace (45 s apart, stop at the first robot check) with the browser's location override set to each point and the page footer confirming the place.

sources.label: Owner-supervised browser capture (Google results, People Also Ask, local pack, ChatGPT, Perplexity)
sources.detail: checked by the main session (claude-in-chrome); human pace, stop at the first robot check
sources.unblock: The main session confirms the claude-in-chrome extension is connected and the owner is present.

sources.label: Conversions (the owner's analytics export, e.g. GA4; no API)
sources.unblock: The owner exports conversions per landing page as JSON [{ page, goal, conversions, start, end }] to <pewp>/captures/conversions.json (stages/measure.md); measure rule MSR-009 reads it.
